observations.body: Joseph sees later generations, announces his death and God’s coming visitation, requires his bones to be carried, and is placed in a coffin in Egypt.
observations.label: Joseph speaks of visitation, binds an oath, and dies

observations.body: The passage presents Joseph binds an oath about his bones and dies as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Joseph binds an oath about his bones and dies

observations.body: The passage places Joseph says God will surely visit Israel beside Joseph binds an oath about his bones and dies.
observations.label: Joseph says God will surely visit Israel

payload.posture: Read Genesis 50:22–26 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states joseph sees later generations, announces his death and God’s coming visitation, requires his bones to be carried, and is placed in a coffin in Egypt. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
payload.title: Joseph speaks of visitation, binds an oath, and dies
